reason: Independent review rejected the generated planning authority. It encoded only 16 of 36 normative conditional rows, duplicated profile/feature dependencies as unconditional edges, provided a shallow schema and validator, implemented no profile-aware scheduler or protocol state machine, replaced exact per-task artifacts/resources/gates with generic placeholders, and supplied only three tests instead of the required mutation, randomized scheduling, lease, packet, and clean-evidence fixtures. The four declared commands passed independently, but green self-tests did not establish the canonical PLAN-001 contract.
